extracted.name: Green olive & herb dressing
extracted.description: Serve this flavourful olive dressing with roast or barbecued lamb. It can be made a day ahead and kept in the fridge
ingredient_lines: extra virgin olive oil for binding
instruction_lines: Finely chop the olives and tip into a bowl with the parsley and mint. Drizzle in enough olive oil to just bind everything, then add the red wine vinegar, golden caster sugar and a pinch of salt. Can be made a day ahead and kept in the fridge.
